total_supply_zero.meaning: gauge _totalSupply equals zero after users withdraw all staked tokens

empty_period_elapsed.meaning: time passes with no deposits while gauge total supply is zero

notify_reward_called.meaning: distribution contract calls notifyRewardAmount to add new rewards during the empty period

rewards_claimable.meaning: reward emissions transferred to the gauge during accrual periods become claimable by users
rewards_claimable.checkpoint: after accrual period and subsequent deposits/interactions

epoch_emissions_stuck.meaning: entire epochs of reward emissions become permanently stuck in the contract without recovery
epoch_emissions_stuck.checkpoint: after accrual period and subsequent deposits/interactions

assumptions: notifyRewardAmount is invoked by the distribution contract, not an unauthorized caller.
The empty period may span an entire reward duration (one week) as described for the full-epoch case.
Reward tokens are transferred to the gauge contract during the empty period.

unresolved.description: Report states notifyRewardAmount 'may be called' during the empty period; whether it was actually called in the incident is not established.
Report does not specify exact reward amounts or token values lost, so the magnitude of protocol fund loss is symbolic.

limitations: The stuck/claimable outcomes are represented as grounded Booleans because the report gives no numeric accrual formula for the skipped periods.
The plan formalizes only v_protocol_fund_loss; other impacts are handled in separate passes.
Whether the empty period covered a full epoch is a potential scenario, not a fixed precondition.
